issues.title: Draft: four concept-led small fish for independent QA
issues.body:
Four distinct concept-led small fish: metaspriggina (inventory entry 543), falcatus (569), pteraspis (548), dorypterus (585). All have genuine ImageGen concepts, frozen briefs, editable volumetric Blender sources, exact GLBs and clean-import proof bundles. Scope remains confined to production/concept-small-fish-20261019.

[Current handoff](https://github.com/s010s/lowpoly-vault/blob/d8c59d6e778f235fccd1e5d451cbfc52b12cb62d/production/concept-small-fish-20261019/HANDOFF.md), [hash bindings](https://github.com/s010s/lowpoly-vault/blob/d8c59d6e778f235fccd1e5d451cbfc52b12cb62d/production/concept-small-fish-20261019/handoff.json), [closure and Skill interpretation](https://github.com/s010s/lowpoly-vault/blob/d8c59d6e778f235fccd1e5d451cbfc52b12cb62d/production/concept-small-fish-20261019/closure-20261019/ACCEPTANCE-NOTES.md), [software-WebGL raw report](https://github.com/s010s/lowpoly-vault/blob/d8c59d6e778f235fccd1e5d451cbfc52b12cb62d/production/concept-small-fish-20261019/closure-20261019/software-webgl/report.json).

Independent QA at f4406976378c132e5ec50c51e839a717ed4418fa passes all four bounded visual/technical/brief/claim-scope reviews, with no geometry repair. All eight GLB/Blend hashes still match reviewed candidate 3196c36c. Khronos has zero errors/warnings; source/export parity, two byte-identical rebuilds per asset and Three.js parsing remain valid.

Closure: 20/20 Chromium 154 / ANGLE SwiftShader software-WebGL scenarios pass: 8 and 32 copies per species plus balanced mixed groups, each in hero/top views. Counts, GL errors, foreground pixels, software renderer identity, 30 render+finish timing samples and inspected screenshots are retained. Mixed groups submit 182 calls / 13,584 triangles at 8 copies and 728 / 54,336 at 32. This is synthetic software rendering, not physical GPU or deployed museum performance acceptance.

Dorypterus current delivered-size description is 0.0996 m (99.6 mm); the historical approximate 0.12 m brief/build scalar remains frozen and no geometry was changed. Pteraspis is explicitly a stylized inspired prop, not an exact scientific reconstruction.

Original PNG C2PA created-action metadata declares 2026-10-19T15:57:08.648462002Z; extraction and source hash retained. Signature/trusted timestamp validation was not run. Exact first pixel-inspection time remains UNKNOWN. Current concept records are valid but strict completeness remains false for that single missing timestamp. The Skill explicitly permits honestly unrecorded timing: this does not overturn the bounded independent pass or automatically reject the models. Formal production acceptance is separate and not asserted by these provisional-study records.

All three main bac6621 CI runs are now confirmed completed/success through a read-only API check; no reruns. Still draft: do not merge, release or deploy autonomously. No production manifest/inventory changes, PR20 modification or historical R1/R2 promotion. Current commit d8c59d6e778f235fccd1e5d451cbfc52b12cb62d; Leon Made This <8357465+s010s@users.noreply.github.com>.

issues.title: Draft: isolated bilingual dual-wheel browser with 9 real models
issues.body:
Build a separate, light-only interaction study for finding, inspecting and downloading nine existing models. The left list continuously scales models around its browse center; only clicking/Enter selects the right detail. Settling follows native inertia, cancels on new input and is disabled for reduced motion. A single GPU renderer serves detail and deliberate hover, with matched preview-only posters, first-frame dissolves, angle-preserving selection, real ground/shadows, draft/apply filters, accessible Info, and same-scale illustrative hand/person comparison. Mobile detail is static until explicit 3D activation.

This is preview-only. Do not merge, deploy over production, resume PR20 or publish assets. Production main remains de413ef720463a2999516faf92c606bcdf9ab1b7 (175 models). Changes are confined to experiments/dual-wheel-preview and qa/dual-wheel-preview; production assets, manifest, app entry and workflows are unchanged. Both original reference PNGs were actually viewed through the authorized private Drive raw-content route; no private image/PRD/credential/download token is committed or packaged. Reference hashes and implementation boundaries are recorded in the experiment README.

Validation: focused state tests, npm run test:preview, npm run test:redesign and the dedicated Chromium browser suite pass. The browser report covers native wheel/selection separation, keyboard/drag/wheel, Info hover/pin/Escape, filter draft/cancel/empty results, Chinese IME, delayed stale loads, failure/retry, Back, real hover angle transfer, comparison camera restore, reduced motion, context loss/restoration, bounded resource cycles, exact source download hashes and 390px mobile opt-in/exit/return. Screenshots cover 1440×900, 1024×768, 390×844 and a 200%-equivalent viewport; a 31-second recorded walkthrough is included.

Run/rebuild commands and evidence: [README](experiments/dual-wheel-preview/README.md), [report](qa/dual-wheel-preview/report.json), [desktop](qa/dual-wheel-preview/desktop-1440.png), [comparison](qa/dual-wheel-preview/comparison-1440.png), [phone](qa/dual-wheel-preview/phone-detail-390.png), [recording](qa/dual-wheel-preview/walkthrough.webm). Source tested: fb25a83f892358e874f1d461dcd6d7e4f1d7be07. Static build command: node experiments/dual-wheel-preview/build.mjs. Output: experiments/dual-wheel-preview/build/index.html; the parent task handles owner-private Sites delivery. No public preview URL is claimed yet.

Limits: nine-model study and query-state URLs, not the full PRD/10k Worker index or production SSG integration. Chromium 154 / SwiftShader functional evidence does not certify hardware performance. Safari, physical devices, native browser zoom/pinch and assistive-technology verification remain outstanding; artistic and interaction acceptance require user trial. The existing model silhouette/palette are preserved rather than remodeled to match the concept art.

This replaces the earlier continuous-publication instruction for this batch.

Catalog changes are editorial data only; no UI redesign.

Completed evidence retained: 1,314 frozen source/QA files, 469 verified handoff hash references, all six exact remote source/QA pins, twelve Chromium 141.0.7390.37 posters (130,306 bytes), local 57-check publication refusal regression, poster integrity regression, complete local build and audit, and all 18 relevant browser-review jobs plus scope. Other already-running PR CI is retained; no production deployment has been initiated.

Independent model QA is reused. static-stylized-v1 / 2026-10-18.1, candidate approval=false, formal acceptance BLOCKED, hardware GPU unverified, reference-access and legacy checker limits remain unchanged.

To resume: obtain the owner's explicit go-ahead after benchmark/natural-appearance calibration, verify any changed source/QA bindings and the current main, then complete required CI before merge. Production main CI/Pages and actual public-origin checks for 187 have not occurred because this candidate has not merged. Do not claim release completion.
